Name: Custom Trash Can
Author: shivaGuy
Description:
[b]Custom Trash Can[/b] allows you to configure/customize the item reclamation price for all levels of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Trash_Cans]Trash Cans[/url].

Edit config.json directly to go beyond 100% refund value. ?

[size=3][u][b]Config Menu[/b][/u][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11835/11835-1651216022-1441590179.png[/img]

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Run the game using SMAPI.﻿

[u][size=4][b]Technical Details
[/b][/size][/u]
This mod uses Harmony to patch the reclaimation price calculation in the game and is not compatible with the mods that do the same.
